The ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.60), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Work finished on time 60% of the time against an expected 47%. Nine jobs are listed for review, and 20 jobs worth ₹6.1 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward has 36 open issues costing ₹13.9 lakh to fix, starting with Marve Road, SV Road and Malad Subway. The remaining ₹6.9 lakh covers only 17 of them.
